title: Two-note dyad, brief
purpose: confirms a brief dyad (no escalation) classifies as simultaneous melody.
expected_prose:
effective_set=[60,67] is a dyad. Duration (300ms <
DYAD_SUSTAIN_THRESHOLD) and repetition count (1 < DYAD_REPETITION_
THRESHOLD) mean no escalation. state=melody for both notes
simultaneously.
